name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source usage-based billing and metering: API, web UI, Sidekiq worker, clock, PDF renderer, PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Public sign-up is disabled. Sign in with LAGO_ORG_USER_EMAIL and the generated LAGO_ORG_USER_PASSWORD from the environment settings. Set your own email there before the first deploy: the organization and admin user are created only on the first start, and later changes to these values are ignored.
